sites.note: confidence=medium. Laramie County approved Crusoe's Project Jade campus, with Tallgrass building the adjacent Cheyenne Power Hub gas plant on a bring-your-own-power model, so no retail utility is established and much of the load may be behind the meter. WACM is the balancing authority covering Cheyenne Light Fuel and Power's territory.

confidence=medium. Lancium owns the 270-acre site and holds the power interconnect; Crusoe designs, builds and operates the 1.0 GW data center. Notably described as grid-connected, unlike Crusoe's behind-the-meter sites, with behind-the-meter solar and storage added. Same Childress ERCOT-not-SPP trap as the existing IREN row. No utility named and ERCOT weather zone left blank.

talk_score_method: magnitude x specificity x scope_breadth, 0-1. How big the number is, how precisely it is stated, and how little it is hedged. Narrowing qualifiers (annual, market-based, certificates, owned-and-operated) reduce scope_breadth.
walk_score_method: mean physical carbon-free share across mapped sites, calendar 2025, all hours, grid-only, unweighted by site size.
notes: Grid-only. Excludes power purchase agreements and renewable energy certificates.
Unweighted across sites; we do not know each site's load.
